linear_attention.peak_basis: Four participating p300c ASICs;120 physical cores/ASIC,nominal1.35GHz,4096 LoFi FLOP/cycle/core;512GB/s/ASIC. Whole-layer maximum per-device firmware envelope includes attention, norms, CCL, movement and gaps.
linear_attention.flops_assumptions: Useful dense projection, logical causal attention/recurrence and scalar work; no MoE or padding counted useful. BFP4/LoFi weights, BFP8 column inputs/CCL, BF16 row inputs/residuals, FP32 sensitive recurrence. Denominator is the four-ASIC LoFi peak, not an achievable mixed-kernel ceiling.
linear_attention.traffic_assumptions: BFP4 tile storage576 bytes/1024 elements, actual local weight padding, compulsory decode projection reads; recurrent/history read+write or4224 prefix KV reads+one token write including BFP8 headers; replicated residual input/output. Excludes intermediate spills, rereads, CCL staging and small constants. Lower-bound estimate, not bus counters.

workload.decode_measurement: Final warmed step at context4224 after128 advancing decode steps
